questions.question: Can a user retrieve and understand their own history?
questions.missing: prospective user utility and production-scale latency

questions.question: Where do users experience friction and recover after repeated attempts?
questions.missing: blinded labels, causal recovery outcomes, changed-agent replay

questions.question: Which traces should become regression evals?
questions.missing: task-correctness labels and prospective production catch rate

questions.question: What durable memories or procedures should be retained?
questions.missing: powered source/context-revision cohort and independently reviewed outcomes

questions.question: Which skills, prompts, or tools are missing?
questions.missing: family-disjoint intervention with held-out skill benefit and rollback

questions.question: How should the system educate or support users?
questions.missing: human-adjudicated support outcomes and non-coercive effectiveness measure

questions.question: Who is doing similar work and can collaboration be suggested?
questions.missing: cross-user authorization-safe labels, similarity utility, and anti-singling-out evaluation

questions.question: Can enterprise-specific embeddings or models improve these answers?
questions.missing: human hard-negative slice, user/project/time-held-out adaptation, and preregistered gain threshold

architecture_conclusion: The current governed PostgreSQL authority plus exact/structured retrieval, OTel/ATIF projections, and quarantined proposal lifecycle supports Q1 and bounded portions of Q2-Q3. It does not yet justify causal claims for Q4-Q8 or adding custom embeddings, graphs, or another database.
